description: Open an ncrypted link (https://.../s/{id}#{key}), decrypt it locally and return the secret. This destroys the secret: it can never be read again. Free. Use the value only for the task at hand and do not repeat it in chat. If the value just needs to end up in a Vercel env var or .env file, use ncrypted_to_vercel_env or ncrypted_to_dotenv instead so you never see it. To check whether someone opened a link you created, use ncrypted_status (it doesn't consume anything).

link.description: The full ncrypted link including the #key fragment.

passphrase.description: Required only if the sender set a passphrase.

name: ncrypted_read
title: Read one-time secret
